name: Date & Time Format Reference
description: Look up the definition and sample value of common date and time formats.

hints.query: Accepts a format key (unix-ms), a name (ISO 8601) or a keyword; typing filters locally, there is nothing to run.
hints.output: Every sample describes the same instant, 2026-10-29T12:00:00Z, so the formats can be compared side by side.

faq.q: Can these formats be converted into each other?
faq.a: Yes, they all describe the same instant; converting only shifts the epoch and the precision, never the absolute time.

faq.q: Why does the Excel serial carry a fraction?
faq.a: It counts one day as 1, so the integer part is midnight and the fraction is the share of the day that has passed.

faq.q: How is this different from the timestamp converter?
faq.a: The converter computes the representations of a given moment; this page is a reference table and takes no time input.
